item.desc: This counter provides the total number of transmitted data in kilobyte contained in the uplink RTP-Mux packet that is sent to the BVG. The total number of octets includes the application payload and IPsec protocol header (ESP) or (where IPsec is employed in tunnel mode) IPsec protocol header (ESP) and UDP+IP encapsulation headers. The application payload consists of the RTP payload, RTP header, RTP-Mux header and UDP+IP header. The IPsec protocol (ESP) and UDP+IP encapsulation header octets are currently estimated.
